# nteguide.com — Neverness to Everness Wiki

> Complete wiki for Neverness to Everness (异环/NTE) by Perfect World.
  42 characters, 42 weapons, 48 guides, tier lists, calculators, redeem codes.

## Key Sections
- [Characters](/en/characters/) — 42 playable characters with builds, skills, teams
- [Weapons](/en/weapons/) — 42 Arc weapons with stats and best users
- [Guides](/en/guides/) — 48 guides: beginners, gacha, farming, system
- [Tier List](/en/tier-list/) — S/A rank tier list updated monthly
- [Redeem Codes](/en/redeem-codes/) — Active gift codes with rewards
- [Calculator](/en/calculator/leveling/) — Material calculator for character leveling
- [FAQ](/en/faq/) — 50+ frequently asked questions
- [Blog](/en/blog/) — Game news and strategy articles
